resources.string: Instantly detects when you open an app you have limited.

Focus Dhikr uses this permission to know, at the exact moment, which app comes to the foreground so it can show your pause screen before you start scrolling.

It does not read the content of your apps, does not store text and does not send anything to any server: the app does not even hold the internet permission.

Without this permission the app still works, but it reacts one or two seconds later.
The persistent notification Android requires to keep the counter running.
You turned this on to make it harder for yourself. If you turn it off, you will be able to uninstall Focus Dhikr right away.
